name: Flexium Interconnect, Inc.
summary: Flexium Interconnect, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, development, manufacture, and sale of flexible printed circuit boards and related products in Taiwan, China, rest of Asia, Europe, and the Americas. The company operates through Printed Circuit Board and Other segments. It offers radio frequency integrated circuit. The company also provides smart home module, flash drive, gesture recognition systems, and radar application modules. Its products are used in wearables, automotive, medical, display, consumer, and antennas application. The company was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
